A listless bird was captured on a beach in Portland, Victoria, on Sunday, August 23, as Australia's avian influenza outbreak continued to spread. Footage here captured by Michelle Crilly of Victorian Wildlife Alliance shows the lifeless greater crested tern on the sand. Victorian Wildlife Alliance said the bird was bagged and disposed, as per Agriculture Victoria guidelines. The sighting came on the same day Australia recorded its first case of bird flu in a mammal following the testing of a long-nosed fur seal found in Beachport, South Australia.
